advances: A weighted raw moment inequality on the original caps, without a quantitative lower bound on its ellipsoid term.
author: PK-research-agent
proof:
Each $Q_z$ is a nonempty compact convex moment set, by weak-* compactness of $0\le f\le1$ in $L^\infty(\mu)$ and continuity of the bounded moment constraints. For each such $f$, pointwise $(L_i)_+\ge fL_i$. Integrating and maximizing the raw continuous moment gives
$$
\Psi_i\ge h_{Q_z}(u_i)+t_z(a_i\cdot z-b_i).
$$
At a pair $(x,\lambda)$ the weighted sum of the affine terms is zero, since $\sum_i\lambda_i(a_i\cdot z-b_i)=\sum_i\lambda_iL_i(z,x)-(\sum_i\lambda_i u_i)\cdot x=0$. Integrate the weighted bound, and sum with the nonnegative coefficients $\eta_z$. Finally ellipsoid containment gives $h_{Q_z}(u_i)\ge u_i\cdot c_z+|A_z^Tu_i|$. The centers cancel after weighting by $\lambda$, by the same balance. In the unframed stress the stated pair conditions and the identity for $W_i$ are its active contact and offset equations.
statement:
Let $\mu$ be the summed volume of finitely many bounded source fibers and let $\Psi_i=\int (L_i)_+\,d\mu$ for affine margins $L_i(z,x)=a_i\cdot z+u_i\cdot x-b_i$. Fix nonnegative weights $\eta_z$ on the sampled bases. All sums involving the associated measures and moment bodies run over the bases of positive weight. Suppose that for each base $z$ with $\eta_z>0$ a probability measure $\nu_z$ on pairs $(x,\lambda)$ satisfies $\lambda\in\Delta_N$, $\sum_i\lambda_i u_i=0$ and $\lambda_iL_i(z,x)=0$ for every $i$. Put $W_i=\sum_z\eta_z\int\lambda_i\,d\nu_z$. For each such $z$ choose a mass $t_z$ for which there exist measurable $0\le f\le1$ with $\int f\,d\mu=t_z$ and $\int wf(w,y)\,d\mu(w,y)=t_z z$. Let $Q_z$ be the body of their raw moments $\int y f(w,y)\,d\mu(w,y)$. Then
$$
\sum_i W_i\Psi_i\ \ge\ \sum_z\eta_z\int\sum_i\lambda_i h_{Q_z}(u_i)\,d\nu_z .
$$
If $c_z+A_zB_d\subseteq Q_z$, where $B_d$ is the Euclidean unit ball, the right side is at least $\sum_z\eta_z\int\sum_i\lambda_i|A_z^Tu_i|\,d\nu_z$. These hypotheses hold for the active pairs and $W_i$ of the unframed whole-space stress.
title: Whole-space saddle weights test raw balanced moment bodies
